opening.text: I've been dizzy, feeling tired, and weak all over, and I have trouble walking. All of this has been going on for two weeks. Four months ago I had a transplant of both lungs, and it went without complications. I take prednisone 20 mg every day and mycophenolate mofetil 1000 mg twice a day.
